mentions.text: @justaladd_ I think its wise to have XLP alongside your growth too

我对记者会的理解是偏hawkish一点点：Warsh说，美联储已经明确展示了“随时采取行动的准备和意愿”——即后续加息仍在桌面上。但他同时说，Fed已经开始看到“金融条件发生变化”。这里大概率就是指向近期长端美债收益率、信用融资成本和AI相关资产波动已经自行收紧。企业投资仍可能以两位数速度增长，因此暂停不是因为经济衰退或需求崩塌。

之后他继续没有直接回答12月会不会加息，仍拒绝传统forward guidance。但是他说，经济和通胀本来支持继续加息，但债券市场与金融条件已经替Fed踩了一部分刹车，因此Fed可以先等数据，而不是今天机械加息。

这相当于给出了一个新的reaction function：

如果股市继续涨、信用利差收窄、长端收益率回落，金融条件重新放松，12月加息概率上升。

如果长端利率继续维持高位、信用市场恶化、AI融资链条继续去杠杆，市场本身的收紧可以替代部分Fed加息。可能后续就不会加息。

fed的意思是，金融风险已经非常大了，所以不能加息，我无法把这个话理解成鸽。

说实话，有一点点恶心。

今天非常混乱，fomc，orcl调capex，msft，googl，ftnt，sndk，非常混乱，这个局，非常难赚钱。

之后我认为，orcl这个事情对soxx来说并不是利好，是一个巨大的利空，我们认为的capex见顶第一次出现在云的话语里。

我nuke了大半仓。

我留intu put，xlp put，bkng put，ms put，inda，一点点qqq put，其他都不要了，等局势清晰再入场。

A lot of people are asking when will AI stocks and technology bounce?

A few things are needed:

1. Energy & oil stocks need to find a top or move sideways (consolidation). Companies like $XOM and $CVX (we hold a big position), continue to stay strong. Once this tops out of "pauses," tech will find a low.

2. Semiconductors to form a potential bull-flag (or a 1:1 measured move) on the weekly timeframe. You can see the $SMH ETF is almost there; a few % lower and could find a stronger floor as well. 

3. Healthcare, a traditionally more late cycle mover, would also need to find a top or move sideways like energy/oil. We can see that healthcare ETF $XLV still does NOT show bearish divergence or buyer exhaustion yet. 

4. Consumer staples ETF $XLP is a pure defensive sector. It's JUST starting to breakout, which would also put some pressure on tech names. Keep an eye out on this sector as well.

So how should you play this to make sure you survive?
• On our end, we continue to remain BALANCED
• We hold great traditional defensive names like $MRK, $KO, $PG, and others
• We also only hold the top strongest fundamentally BEST growth names 
• For any high-volatility and risky names, we hold a smaller allocation of 2.5% max for each stock, with 10% max total portfolio allocation.

We're getting close for AI stocks for at least a larger relief bounce soon. But there's still some pressure here. 

Rain or shine, continue to stay invested and buy MORE with your paychecks. You will become rich by doing so. 

Survive, then thrive. Let's go. 💪
